messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "diuretic"
set: ["diuretic", "loop diuretic", "potassium-sparing diuretic", "used with diuretic", "weaker diuretic than furosemide", "especially diuretic or water pill", "this diuretic holds on to potassium", "adjust diuretic dose to minimize hypovolemia", "may reduce dose after adding diuretic", "add low dose diuretic if blood pressure not controlled", "additional diuretic therapy for people with significantly reduced kidney function", "especially diuretic or water pill that may increase blood potassium", "especially when an agent with greater diuretic potential is desired", "process continues until the desired diuretic effect has been obtained", "low potassium can be managed with a different type of diuretic", "dose that provided the desired diuretic effect once or twice a day"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
